title: Store
description: Represents a merchant store or inventory system connected to the ingestion engine. Store records are created manually during merchant onboarding — not pulled from APIs. One store = one platform account.

id.description: Your internal unique store ID. Generated by your system. Must be unique.

name.description: Human-readable store name. Entered manually during onboarding. Must not be empty.

platform.description: Which platform this store runs on. Determines which connector, transformer, and auth method to use.

x-notes.shopify: GraphQL Admin API — requires access token
x-notes.magento: REST API v1 — requires OAuth bearer token
x-notes.woocommerce: REST API v3 at /wp-json/wc/v3/ — requires consumer key + secret
x-notes.unicommerce: REST API — inventory + product data only, not a storefront. Requires facility code + auth token
x-notes.bigcommerce: REST API v2/v3 — requires client_id + access_token. Multi-step: brands and categories need separate calls
x-notes.generic: Scraping fallback — no API credentials needed

domain.description: Store's primary domain or base URL. Used to construct product URLs and API endpoints. Must be valid URL/domain format.

logoUrl.description: URL to the store's logo. Entered manually during onboarding.

isActive.description: Whether this store is currently being synced. Set to false to pause without deleting.

syncFrequency.description: How often your system pulls data from this store. Dictates cron job routing.

x-notes.shopify: realtime — webhooks for live price/stock updates
x-notes.magento: hourly — poll-based, no reliable webhooks for all events
x-notes.woocommerce: hourly — webhooks available but less reliable than Shopify
x-notes.bigcommerce: hourly — webhooks available for product/inventory changes

credentials.description: API credentials for connecting to this store. CRITICAL: Never store plain text in production. Always encrypt at rest using AES-256. Never log these values. Must contain valid auth fields based on platform.

accessToken.description: Shopify: Admin API access token. Magento: OAuth bearer token.

apiKey.description: Shopify: API Key. BigCommerce: Client ID.

apiSecret.description: Shopify: API Secret. BigCommerce: Client Secret.

consumerKey.description: WooCommerce only. Consumer Key from WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.

authToken.description: Unicommerce only. Auth token from Unicommerce login API.

storeHash.description: BigCommerce only. Store hash from the BigCommerce control panel URL.

storeUrl.description: Full base URL used for API calls. Must include https://.

metaData.description: Store configuration used for fallbacks and localization.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Used as fallback when platform does not return currency in API response. Must follow ISO 4217 (e.g., INR, USD).

timezone.description: IANA timezone. Used for scheduling sync jobs at correct local time.

syncConfig.description: Fine-grained sync configuration per store. These values override global defaults and must be configurable — never hardcoded.

availabilityThreshold.description: Stock qty at or below this = 'limited'. 0 = 'out_of_stock'. Above this = 'in_stock'. Directly feeds the Offer schema availability logic.

batchSize.description: Products per API call. Shopify max=250. Magento default=10. WooCommerce default=10. BigCommerce max=250.

retryAttempts.description: How many times to retry a failed API call before marking as error.

rateLimitDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait between API calls to avoid hitting rate limits. Shopify: 500ms. Magento: 1000ms. WooCommerce: 500ms. BigCommerce: 500ms.

ingestionType.description: Whether this store provides full product data or inventory/pricing only. Unicommerce is inventory-only — it updates existing offer records created by other platforms.

x-notes.unicommerce: inventory-only — updates stockQty, availability, and price on existing offers. Does NOT create new products.

createdAt.description: When this store was added to your system.

lastSyncedAt.description: When your system last completed a successful full sync for this store. Null if never synced.
